term: grammar fixed by the practice's authorities
definition: `C.AuthoritiesFixGrammar`: what counts as a correct move of the practice is settled by its recognized authorities (for the Catholic practice, the magisterium: councils and the pope teaching definitively).
note: One answer to who fixes a practice's grammar (owner decision 2026-11-06, #1010). A proposition about the practice, constrained only through STMT-AUTHORITY-GRAMMAR-MAKES-DEFINITIONS-OWN-STANDARD.

formal_gap.meaning: CasedPractice.AuthoritiesFixGrammar is a proposition about one practice: what counts as a correct move of the practice is settled by its recognized authorities (for the Catholic practice, the magisterium: councils and the pope teaching definitively). It is one cell of the three grammar-fixing cases (owner decision 2026-11-06, #1010), supplied by each model.
examples: The Catholic practice, read with the magisterium as its grammar-fixing authority.
exclusions: Grammar fixed by ordinary practitioners' use (UseFixesGrammar), the second cell.
The case where neither authorities nor ordinary use fix the grammar, the third cell.
open_obligations: Constrained only through STMT-AUTHORITY-GRAMMAR-MAKES-DEFINITIONS-OWN-STANDARD, which remains open.
Coverage of the three cells is the open statement STMT-FIDEISM-GRAMMAR-CASES-COVER; the cells are not assumed exclusive beyond its stated form.
Which cell holds for the Catholic practice is not decided by any record.
No formalization candidate from existing vocabulary.
